2607.25446.title: Toward an Organizational Science of Multi-Agent LLM Systems: Decoupling Who, How, and Which Algorithm
2607.25446.paper_summary: Multi-agent frameworks built on large language models (LLMs) routinely entangle three logically distinct concerns: who is on the team (organization), how members align (coordination), and which algorithm fuses their work (collaboration protocol). IMACS (Intelligent Multi-Agent Collaboration System) separates the three into orthogonal, independently swappable layers. Classic organizational theory (Belbin roles, Mintzberg coordination, RACI accountability) becomes executable, validated configuration, and the framework places six published collaboration algorithms behind a common interface while exposing roles, coordination, and accountability as independently configurable factors. We use this separation to conduct controlled comparisons in which organizational assignments vary while the collaboration protocol is held fixed. It also turns protocol choice into a variable that can be learned: Adaptive Org Routing, a contextual-bandit meta-protocol, selects a protocol per task under an explicit quality-cost tradeoff, outperforms every fixed protocol in a controlled study, and trains online on real benchmark and LLM-judge rewards. The ablations expose a mechanism. Accountability placement changes outcomes exactly when the protocol routes the deliverable through the accountable agent, and the winning placement flips across model families, so organizational design cannot be hard-coded; it must be revalidated, or learned, for each model binding.
2607.25446.paper_summary_zh: 多代理框架基於大型語言模型 (LLMs) 通常會糾纏三個邏輯上不同的問題：團隊成員是誰（組織）、成員如何協調（協調）以及哪種算法融合他們的工作（協作協議）。IMACS（智能多代理協作系統）將這三者分離為正交的、獨立可互換的層。經典的組織理論（Belbin 角色、Mintzberg 協調、RACI 責任）變成可執行的、經過驗證的配置，而該框架將六個已發表的協作算法放在一個共同的介面後面，同時將角色、協調和責任暴露為獨立可配置的因素。我們利用這種分離進行控制比較，其中組織分配變化，而協作協議保持固定。這也使得協議選擇變成一個可以學習的變量：自適應組織路由，一種上下文強盜元協議，根據明確的質量-成本權衡為每個任務選擇一個協議，在控制研究中超越了每個固定協議，並在真實基準和 LLM 評判獎勵上進行在線訓練。消融實驗揭示了一種機制。責任的配置恰好在協議將可交付成果通過負責代理人路由時改變結果，而獲勝的配置在模型系列之間翻轉，因此組織設計不能被硬編碼；它必須為每個模型綁定重新驗證或學習。
